info.title: fitcheck-invitationcenter-service API
info.description: Manages invite-only onboarding links for platform operators, including creation, activation, delivery, validation, and audit tracking of unique registration invite tokens.

post.description:
This operation requires session parameters: ownerUserId (ID, required).
To access the route, the session should have roles: **[admin, superAdmin]**.

201.description: Response JSON represents the most comprehensive form of the **inviteLink** object in the response. However, some properties may be omitted based on the object's internal logic.

400.description: The request was improperly formatted or contained invalid parameters, preventing the server from processing it.

401.description: The request lacked valid authentication credentials or the credentials provided do not grant access to the requested resource.

404.description: The requested resource was not found on the server.

500.description: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
